name: singlet_spatial_registration_pairwise_slice_correspondence
title: Pairwise slice correspondence
description: Computes a soft correspondence between the spots or cells of two adjacent spatial sections by fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport, balancing expression similarity against preserved spatial distances. Use it to link neighbouring sections before label transfer or multi-section analysis; it reads counts and coordinates and writes a coupling with per-unit matches. Do not use it for cross-technology or cross-resolution pairs, which have no validated benchmark here. It never changes layers/counts.

dataset.description: Source section handle: a .singlet path or URI, or a workspace handle. Rows of the coupling index this section.

target_dataset.description: Target section handle. Columns of the coupling index this section; its coordinates come from obsm/spatial.

method.description: paste: balanced fused GW, the published standard. paste2: partial overlap. moscot: entropic unbalanced fused GW.

alpha.description: Spatial weight: 0 uses expression only, 1 spatial distances only; moscot accepts (0, 1]; null uses the method default.

use_rep.description: obsm key used as the expression representation instead of layers/counts.

normalize_spatial.description: Scale spatial distances per section; null uses the method default.

marginals_key.description: obs column of non-negative weights for both sections; null means uniform marginals.

max_iterations.description: Cap on outer iterations; null uses the method default.

dissimilarity.description: Expression cost: KL between proportion profiles with a pseudocount, or Euclidean.

overlap_fraction.description: Fraction s of mass to transport, at most the smaller total mass of the two sections; null means balanced transport, as in paste.

moscot.description: Options for method moscot (entropic unbalanced fused GW).

epsilon.description: Entropic regularisation; the cost is rescaled by its mean.

tau_a.description: Unbalanced penalty on the source marginal; 1 is balanced.

tau_b.description: Unbalanced penalty on the target marginal; 1 is balanced.

rank.description: -1 selects the full-rank solver; a positive value selects low-rank GW.

output_key.description: Prefix of every written member, for example models/<output_key>/coupling.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when the method has a CUDA path and memory allows.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak memory and device without computing the coupling.

overwrite.description: Replace existing members with the same output_key instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the source dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example models/s2_s3/coupling. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed jobs: method, sizes, total mass, objective, iterations and overlap fraction.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
